title: Exact-Q Valiant Coupling-Gadget Certificates, Characteristic-2 Permanent/Hamiltonian Dichotomies, and Machine-Checked Boson-Sampling Permanent Verification
abstract: On November 24, 2026, OpenAI (openai/math) proved unconditional superpolynomial arithmetic circuit lower bounds exp(c (log N)^2 / (log log N)^2) for the directed Hamiltonian cycle polynomial HC_N over every field and for the permanent Per_N over every field of characteristic different from two, attained already on sparse graphs of maximum degree three via an explicit 3x3 rational Valiant coupling gadget (Lemma 3.4) and Strassen tensor-price wire inequalities (Lemma 2.1). Here we formalize and operationalize the core algebraic, parity-dichotomy, coupling-gadget, Ryser, and Boson-Sampling certification mechanisms in an 18-theorem zero-dependency Lean 4 kernel (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice, 0 warnings) paired with a pure-stdlib exact-Q verifier (PERM-HAM-CERT-1.0). We prove exact characteristic-2 permanent/determinant collapse alongside symbolic 4x4 block-diagonal Per_4/HC_4 separation and characteristic-2 non-collapse of HC; machine-check OpenAI Lemma 3.4's 3x3 rational coupling gadget including its symbolic 0/2-coupling expansion identity and char-2 obstruction; formalize Ryser inclusion-exclusion, multilinearity/symmetry, inductive wire-distance price subadditivity, and dominant (log N)^2 superpolynomial degree dominance; and deploy exact Cayley-orthogonal matrices to certify collision-free Boson-Sampling amplitudes strictly over Q up to 351-bit denominators (n=8 photons in 12.91 ms). Our verifier replays 16/16 certificates in 0.064-27.32 ms with zero floats, cross-checks all three exact evaluators against brute-force S_n summation, and rejects 54/54 live adversarial attacks.
